description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Dark with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Dark Mode I (Rufus)] and [Dark Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Dark Mode I (Rufus)
description.text: Dark abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Dark Shot after using equipped Dark abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Dark Mode II (Rufus)], removes [Dual Awoken Dark Mode I (Rufus)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Dark Mode II (Rufus)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 20000, Dark abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time, instant cast speed for Dark abilities, critical chance =100%

description.name: Dual Dark Shot
description.text: Two single ranged attacks (1.02 each), 100% hit rate, causes [Imperil Dark 10% (15s)] every second activation, grants [Quick Cast 1] to the user every second activation

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3
